scope: One disposable unchanged original brick surface; CPU only; no full model bake
geometry: Select complete connected original triangles; exact source vertex positions/winding/multiplicity, no repair or modified master
UV: One YZ planar chart; 1024 square; 16 texel margin; analytic positive-area overlap rejection at 1e-12 UV-square tolerance; every face has covered texel
source_sampler: Pinned native eight-neighbour sparse trilinear, renormalize found in-bounds support; no support gives six zero channels
native_exporter_difference: No GPU unwrap, simplification, repair or BVH execution. Original selected surface unchanged, so closest-point projection is identity. Native GPU floating-point bitwise equivalence remains untested.
packing: Native F32 sample times255, clip0..255, truncate toU8. RGB remains encoded; MR=(unused0,roughness,metallic), alpha retained. Original Telea padding only outside covered raster. PNG rows flip for bottom-up UV V.
portable_material: Embedded PNG GLB; RGB sRGB; MR Non-Color; OPAQUE; no AO or invented details

quality.test_points: Every face centroid plus10000 deterministic area-weighted surface samples
quality.filter: Decode sRGB texels tolinear before bilinear; re-encode for encoded-RGB error
quality.limits_are: Predeclared proof tolerances, not universal quality criteria or measured GPU parity

comparison: Direct original learned vertex RGB**2.2 before interpolation versus genuine spatial baked field with standard sRGB; separate semantic differences from texture discretization
stages: One fresh Blender GLB import plus matched direct/baked renders
stop: No retries of failed resource-heavy stages; no full bake, repair, model execution, environment changes or publication of private assets
